description: Save a draft Chief plan (goals and milestones) you've written for the user's repo, and get a sign-up link (claim_url) that turns it into a Chief project. Works without a Chief account. Use the chief_plan_from_repo prompt to write the plan. Don't include secrets, code, file contents or personal data: plans with code blocks or anything that looks like a key are refused. Show the user claim_url.

goals.description: Outcomes the project is working toward, not tasks.

milestones.description: In the order they should run.

definition_of_done.description: Checks a coding agent can verify.

objective.description: What the milestone delivers and why, in plain words.

size.description: S: under a day of agent work; M: a day or two; L: more.

name.description: Project name, usually the repository's name.

repo_language.description: The repo's main programming language, e.g. TypeScript (for statistics only).

name: save_draft_plan
title: Save a draft Chief plan
